title_ru: Экспериментальная телеметрия JANUS BFaiN / HRAIN / TACHYON — нормализованная provenance-капсула
analysis_method: Archive extraction through a local RAR reader with path-traversal protection.
Static parsing of JSON, CSV, and text logs only.
No source program, model, script, bridge, device command, or telemetry producer was executed.
Raw rows, free-form HRAIN content, host paths, disk layout, and binary events were not admitted.
core_findings: The archive records a chronological schema-evolution lineage of 6240 landscape observations from 2026-02-23 through 2026-03-05.
The selected best_config record is directly present in the newest landscape_map.csv source.
Training traces include two-seed step logs and parseable per-parameter gradient summaries.
A large unheaded nine-column beacon stream contains 129799 rows across 28 apparent monotonic-time segments.
The HRAIN state is a concrete graph snapshot with 3006 nodes and 1103 links, but its labels, descriptions, and chat content are not reproduced.
No credential-shaped API key or bot-token pattern was detected by the applied static scan; operational paths and host-layout details were present and therefore excluded.
boundaries: These are producer-generated observational logs, not an independently reproduced benchmark.
Internal field names such as score, lethal, homeostatic, entropy, and mutual_info_unbiased retain producer semantics and are not independently validated scientific measurements.
The beacon file has no header; columns are reported only as positional columns c0 through c8.
Schema drift within landscape CSV files prevents treating them as one clean table without an explicit migration.
Nothing in this capsule is evidence of consciousness, biological homeostasis, quantum computation, or a solution to P versus NP.
The raw archive is not committed.
